specs.title: TC-FR13-001 — unauthenticated visit to the admin app renders the 'Admin Login' form instead of the dashboard
TC-FR13-002 — successful login with the seeded admin credentials renders the dashboard tab by default
TC-FR13-003 — the dashboard header 'Dashboard' is rendered after login
TC-FR13-004 — the 'Tổng doanh thu (Delivered)' stat card is rendered
TC-FR13-005 — the 'Tổng số đơn hàng' stat card is rendered
TC-FR13-006 — adding N pending orders increases the dashboard's total order count by exactly N
TC-FR13-007 — adding N pending orders does NOT change the delivered revenue
TC-FR13-008 — adding ONE delivered order increases the displayed revenue by amount * 2 (proves the SUT's '× 2' defect)
TC-FR13-009 — BVA: adding a 1 VND delivered order increases the revenue by 2
TC-FR13-010 — BVA: adding a 30,000,000 VND delivered order increases the revenue by 60,000,000
TC-FR13-011 — login as a non-admin account shows the 'role check' alert and does NOT render the dashboard
TC-FR13-012 — login with the wrong password shows the 'Đăng nhập thất bại' alert and the form remains
TC-FR13-013 — before login, the sidebar nav items (Dashboard, Danh mục, Sản phẩm, ...) are NOT rendered
TC-FR13-014 — after login, the sidebar nav items are rendered (at least the 'Dashboard' tab is visible)
TC-FR13-015 — clicking the 'Đơn hàng' sidebar tab switches away from the dashboard
TC-FR13-016 — the revenue stat card formats the number with Vietnamese grouping and a '₫' suffix
TC-FR13-017 — BUG-FR-13-001 detector: dashboard revenue must NOT equal the correct sum of delivered amounts. Fails on the buggy SUT where revenue shows twice the actual value.
